items.title: Euro area inflation nudges up in August to 3.2% as energy prices jump
items.summary: Eurozone August final CPI +3.2% vs +3.3% y/y expected Prior +2.9% Eurozone August final core CPI +2.4% vs +2.4% y/y expected Prior +2.5% The breakdownThe final estimate shows a mild revision lower to headline annual inflation, recording 3.2% in August.
items.impactZh: 关键宏观数据超预期时，点差与滑点风险通常放大，建议降低仓位并控制杠杆。
items.impactEn: When macro data surprises, spread/slippage risk often widens; consider smaller position size and tighter leverage control.
